tools.name: get_record
tools.description: One firm by its registry id. Without a subscription key this returns the open fields and says how many named roles the full record holds; with one it returns the named roles, the contact channels, the full source list and the verification note.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_registry" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search verified family offices and related firms in Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Austria and Germany, and single-family offices in Dubai (free, with no named peo…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
